raw_text: Following the Niger coup closely. There are reports of coordinated social media campaigns supporting the junta. Pro-coup accounts are flooding X and Telegram with anti-France content and Russian flags. Some accounts appear to have been dormant for months and suddenly activated. The pattern is very similar to what we saw in Mali and Burkina Faso coups. Wagner Group involvement is being widely speculated.
clean_text: Coordinated social media campaigns supporting Niger junta detected. Dormant accounts activated to spread anti-France and pro-Russia content. Pattern similar to Mali and Burkina Faso coups. Wagner involvement speculated.
